en: Non-woven polypropylene is a plastic material. It can be designed for repeated use, but recycled content, recyclability and reuse are different questions.

en: Management-system certificates describe the certified organization and scope. They do not by themselves establish a bag’s environmental performance.

en: The scan also states 26 January 2027, subject to successful continuing assessment and annual fees. Confirm current status with the issuer.

en: Details above are transcribed from the scans published by Kobags. These are management-system certificates, not product environmental certifications. ISO develops standards; certification bodies issue certificates. The current status and relationship of the named entity to Kobags require confirmation before procurement.
sq: Detajet janë transkriptuar nga skanimet e publikuara nga Kobags. Janë certifikata të sistemit të menaxhimit, jo certifikata mjedisore të produktit. ISO harton standardet; organet certifikuese lëshojnë certifikatat. Konfirmoni statusin aktual dhe lidhjen e subjektit me Kobags para prokurimit.
